findings.title: Lightness values swapped for embedded-post username link, changing light-theme color
findings.body: In `.embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a`, the original rule was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))` — the two lightness values appear to have been swapped. For light themes this changes the rendered color from 30% to 70% lightness (much lighter username links in embedded/expanded posts), an unintended visual regression on light themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: custom-message-length lightness inverted on light themes and inconsistent with desktop
findings.body: `.custom-message-length` was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` and is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme value changed from 70% to 30%, so the hint text under the flag modal becomes much darker on light themes. The desktop counterpart (`desktop/modal.scss`) was converted correctly as 70%/30%, so mobile and desktop now diverge. The light-theme argument should remain 70%.

findings.title: group-member-info .name light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In `.group-member-info .name`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. For light themes the color shifts from 30% to 50% lightness, which is an unintended visual change rather than a dark-theme adaptation. To preserve light-theme appearance it should use 30% for the light argument (and typically 70% for the dark one).

findings.title: group-member-info .name light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In `.group-member-info .name`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. On light themes this lightens the group member name from 30% to 50%, an unintended change to light-theme rendering. The light argument should stay at 30% to preserve existing appearance.

findings.title: topic-map h3 light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50%, inconsistent with desktop
findings.body: `.topic-map h3` was `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` and is now `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme value changed from 20% to 50%, making the topic-map heading significantly lighter on light themes. The desktop equivalent (`desktop/topic-post.scss` `.topic-map h3`) was converted as 20%/80%, so mobile now renders differently from desktop. The light argument should remain 20%.
